thread:
Marta: quick PSA: tenant 'harbor' toggled v2 but our billing dashboard still shows all traffic under v1.
Jin: do we attribute billing to requested or executed variant today?
Alex: executed. so fallbacks make tenant usage look lower for preferred model.
Marta: support gets slapped with confused customers. They see "v2 enabled" but quota meter doesn't move.
Sam: proposal: keep quota attribution to requested variant (customer-facing) and keep infra cost attribution to executed variant (internal). Need telemetry fields: requested_tag, executed_tag, fallback=true/false.
Beth: UX: console should show both tags inline with a tiny reason line when mismatch. Example: "Requested: redwood-v2 · Effective: redwood-v1 (kv-cache-mismatch)"
Jin: also add a small amber "sticky" badge when config != effective for >15s. That prevents customers thinking toggle is immediate.
Sam: I'll add metrics: counter fallbacks_total{tenant,requested,executed,reason} and gauge pending_config_mismatch. Also a reconcile job that checks nightly if requested_quota != executed_infra > 5% and alert.
Marta: can we sample full traces for 0.5% of fallbacks so SRE/devs can debug kv-cache issues?
Alex: yes, enable trace sampling on fallback_reason for a rolling 7d window.
Beth: I'll update console mock and copy. Add tooltip explaining billing split and a link to the reconcile report.
Telemetry-bot: PR patch/eng-platform/fallback-telemetry (3299) created by sam — CI passed.
Marta: thanks. Action: Sam (metrics + PR), Beth (UI copy + badge), Alex (trace sampling + precedence doc), Jin (help QA).
Sam: enabling 0.5% fallback trace sampling on affected routes now.
Jin: will QA on staging.
Alex: one more: document precedence order in spec to avoid ambiguity. token header -> tenant override -> route default -> global.
Marta: agreed. closing loop once staging deploys.
